body:
Icosian Cubomancer
CR 5

A 20-sided die creature, made of a translucent blue material akin to crystal or ice, stands before you. The bipedal being has yellow eyes with black slit pupils, numbered facets, and four clawed limbs. Smaller dice of similar material float around him, adding to his mystical aura.

XP 1,600
Icosian Cubomancer 5
CN Medium outsider (native)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 12, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +2 natural, +3 armor)
hp 27 (5d6+10)
Fort +2, Ref +3, Will +5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee quarterstaff +2 (1d6)
Ranged light crossbow +4 (1d8/19-20)
Special Attacks Polyhedral Matrices

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 14, Con 12, Int 16, Wis 12, Cha 8
Base Atk +2; CMB +2, CMD 14
Feats Craft Arcane Die, Improved Initiative, Toughness
Skills Appraise +11, Craft (alchemy) +11, Fly +10, Knowledge (arcana) +11, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +11, Knowledge (engineering) +11, Knowledge (geography) +11, Knowledge (history) +11, Knowledge (local) +11, Knowledge (nature) +11, Knowledge (nobility) +11, Knowledge (planes) +11, Knowledge (religion) +11, Linguistics +11, Profession (Wis), Spellcraft +11
Languages Common, Icosian, Modron
SQ recalculations, lucky stone

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Polyhedral Matrices (Sp)

The icosian cubomancer can form a probable list of spells into small, multisided matrices.

Chaos Coins d2: Light, Magic Missile

Tetrahedral Matrix d4: Detect Magic, Shield, Mage Armor, Scorching Ray

Cubic Matrix d6: Magic Missile, Invisibility, Mirror Image, Levitate, Fireball

Recalculations

At 5th level, the icosian cubomancer can unmake and remake all polyhedral matrices using entirely new spells.

Lucky Stone (Su)

The icosian cubomancer can create a lucky stone for free at level 1, and every 10 levels after that. The lucky stone is a icosahedron-shaped gem with arcane symbols engraved into it.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary, pair, or hoard (5-7)
Gear quarterstaff, light crossbow with 20 bolts, amulet of natural armor +1, bracers of armor +3, lucky stone, other standard adventuring gear
